reader.notes: The determination is documented (DOC-A.1-151) and the probe's file bytes match it. An FD with no RECORD clause over an OCCURS DEPENDING ON record yields fixed records at the maximum size, an implementor choice §1985:II.2.1.4.3 allows; this rule then has no variable-length record to speak of.

refuter.evidence: The reader's requirement: with no RECORD DELIMITER clause WiseOwl specifies its method (DOC-A.1-151: 4-byte little-endian length prefix; DOC-A.1-146 (b)/(c'): a RECORD VARYING record of a record sequential print stream is 'framed exactly as in (b)' with the print controls written between records, a LINAGE file is unframed text) 'and must write and read by it'. Probe rd_print-001 (--std 85, E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-221/runs/rd_print-001): FB = RECORD IS VARYING IN SIZE FROM 1 TO 10 DEPENDING ON LB, no LINAGE, no RECORD DELIMITER, written WRITE FB-REC AFTER ADVANCING 1 LINE twice (L=4 'AB  ', L=3 'CDE') -> 'W 00 00 00'; CLOSE; OPEN INPUT FB through the same FD -> 39; READ -> 47 (stdout 'OPEN INPUT 39 39 39', 'LAST 47 47 47'). RDPB.DAT = 0a 04 00 00 00 41 42 20 20 0a 03 00 00 00 43 44 45 0a: the documented prefix IS written, with LF controls between frames, and the reader refuses its own method's output. FA (LINAGE, no clause, no ADVANCING phrase) and rd_linage2-001 (LINAGE, DEPENDING ON) the same: OPEN INPUT 39. --std 2023 identical (rd_print-002): cause (b). Non-print variable-length files read back correctly (rd_sizes-002, rd_reversed-001 incl. 1985 REVERSED and EXTEND), so the defect is the print-stream arm of the method. Code: SequentialConnector.cs#FixedAttributeConflict returns 39 when IsVarying && !RecordFraming.StreamFramingParses(HostPath); its own remarks say 'writing a print, report or extract file and reading it back ... is exactly the idiom' the 04/06/09 statuses exist for. 39 is defined only as a conflict between the fixed file attributes and the program's (§1985:VII.1.3.5 item f); the FD that created the file has none. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VII.2.8.4 GR4  (║2.8.4 General Rules║)  the text is in GR4'; 'OK  §1985:VII.1.3.5  (1.3.5 I-O Status)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GRL2.3f'; 'OK  §1985:VII.4.7.4 GR16  (4.7.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR16'; 'OK  §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR11  (3.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR11'. Fixed-length sibling (outside this rule, same mechanism family): rd_print_fixed-002 reads CR/LF control bytes into the record area and misaligns records (§1985:II.2.1.4). kb/Work: none found (PB1664, PB2509 cover the print-stream write form; PB2754 torn tails).
